description: This file defines the class CaseEventsHook, which handles tracking changes to specific fields in case records within SuiteCRM. It compares old and new case beans to generate event records when certain fields change, and saves update events.

classes.name: CaseEventsHook
classes.description: A hook class for tracking and recording changes to case records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: compareBeans
methods.description: Compares two case beans and creates event records for each changed field.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Saves update events for a case bean if relevant fields have changed.
